title: Visual QA and evidence
purpose: Close implementation states only when browser evidence matches the source frames closely enough.
entry_condition: A screen state or modal state has been implemented in local WordPress.
exit_condition: Desktop/mobile screenshots, console checks, frame drift notes, and Agentic Ops snapshot/export are complete.
acceptance_criteria: Every completed visual task has observable evidence.
The admin reads as the approved product system, not a generic settings page.
MCP snapshot/export are created after validation passes.
